findings.issue: Typo: doubled kana in the clarification note — 'the もも of もらえ' should be 'the も of もらえ'. The grammatical claim itself is correct, but もも could confuse a beginner.
findings.current: Note: the もも of もらえ is part of the verb もらう, NOT the concessive 〜ても of the target.
findings.suggested: Note: the も of もらえ is part of the verb もらう, NOT the concessive 〜ても of the target.

findings.issue: Same typo as expl_en: doubled kana — 'o もも de もらえ' should be 'o も de もらえ'.
findings.current: Observação: o もも de もらえ é parte do verbo もらう, NÃO o 〜ても concessivo do alvo.
findings.suggested: Observação: o も de もらえ é parte do verbo もらう, NÃO o 〜ても concessivo do alvo.

findings.issue: 'Tried doing a diet' (try + gerund) implies the diet was actually carried out; しようとした marks an attempt that may not have happened — the very nuance the explanation teaches. The literal mirror should use 'tried to do'.
findings.suggested: I tried to do a diet.
